pro_course_detail.title: Reach for English! A Fun, Interactive Course to Build Reading, Speaking, & Writing Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
*This course is geared toward children ages 4 - 12. *

What will I learn in this course?
Reach for English is a course designed in collaboration with National Geographic Learning. It is a fun, interactive course with 3 Main Emphases: Reading, Speaking, & Writing. The lessons are all based on picture book stories, focusing on the development of reading skills. We will build English skills by focusing on phonics, grammar, spelling, listening & speaking comprehension, and oral writing.

What happens during a lesson?
In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for today’s lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, introduce new vocabulary and grammar, and play practise games. Together, we will read a story and practise discussion skills by asking and answering questions about the story as we read. We will end our lesson by writing sentences about the story using our new vocabulary.

How long is this course?
Each Course is 30 lessons long and may be purchased by individual lesson or in 10-course increments. 

What level is this course?
This course is accessible to Levels PREK - G4A. 

How is my progress?
I provide written feedback after every fifth lesson. This personalised report will provide a constructive, encouraging review of your listening and speaking skills, classroom engagement, foundational skills, and reading & oral writing skills. 

Can I review lessons after class?
Yes! All lessons are recorded independently by me and will be forwarded to the client after each session. Recordings are to ensure continued quality. Student information remains private.

What materials do you provide for each lesson?
Prior to each lesson, I provide relevant student enrichment materials such as practise book pages and videos. I do not require a student to have reviewed or completed these materials prior to the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading Tree - Learn English Through the Adventures of Kipper, Chip, Biff & More!
pro_course_detail.description:
*This course is geared toward children ages 4 - 12. *

What will I learn in this course?
Reading Tree is a course designed by Oxford University Press around the Oxford Reading Tree series. This course is designed to facilitate the development of essential English skills for effective learning through reading while helping learners become independent readers. In each lesson, we will build English skills by focusing on reading strategies & skills, vocabulary, speaking, fluency, phonics & phonological awareness, and writing.

What happens during a lesson?
In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for that lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, learn phonics, and improve pronunciation. Together, we will read a story and discuss it, building comprehension, vocabulary, and accuracy. Afterwards, we will practise retelling the story, practise free talk using new vocabulary, and practise oral writing.

How long is this course?
Each Course is 30 lessons long and may be purchased by individual lesson or in 10-course increments. 

What level is this course?
This course is accessible to Levels PREK - G2B.

pro_course_detail.title: 7 Easy Ways to Improve Your Vocabulary Fast and Overcome the Struggle (A1 - C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Words are the basic blocks of the language, and one of the key predictors of someone’s education level, profession, and social status. Yet most students struggle to increase their vocabulary effectively, as unfamiliar words go one into one ear and out the other.

It’s not that we have difficulties grasping the vocabulary when we see it. Rather, we struggle to recall when we use it, or worse yet, forget to use it frequently enough only to end up back where we began.

This lesson will describe seven proven tactics to overcome this struggle and learn new words faster, recall them more effectively, and remember them forever.

teacher_info.about_teacher: In 2006, I began teaching English as a second language to international students at Western Michigan University. I have taught students from all over the world: Saudi Arabia, China, France, and the Dominican Republic are among some of the places my students call home.  I specialize in academic and professional English focused on speaking, listening, grammar, reading and writing. However, I have also worked with students developing basic vocabulary, pronunciation, and conversational skills. Although I am rooted in the United States, my greatest pleasure in teaching English comes from the connections I make to other lands and cultures through my students.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My general approach to language instruction is task-based.  Rather than focusing on discrete grammar points or lengthy vocabulary definitions, I ask my students to use and stretch their language skills by performing communicative tasks.  Example tasks might include creating a professional powerpoint or reading an article from a peer-review journal. The goal is to practice English in authentic, real-world situations. However, an understanding of grammar and vocabulary is important as well and are dealt with as needed in the context of communication. For example, I use the Academic Word List (AWL) to help draw attention to key words used in nearly all professions and university majors.

course_info.trial_description:
It usually feels very scary to book a first lesson. Maybe you have had bad experiences with English learning in the past. Perhaps it feels strange to meet a stranger on a computer. And of course - trying something new is always scary! And I'm a new person and learning English this way - may be a new thing for you! 

But please don't worry! You're not alone. Nearly EVERYONE feels this way. It was the same for me when I had my first online class. 

I will bring care and empathy to every lesson, and especially the first one. In the trial lesson, I won't be evaluating you. I will not correct your mistakes on our first call together. 

Instead - my intention is that you feel comfortable and relaxed. I want you to see what I am like as a teacher, and I want to get to know you! 

I know your abilities are better than they will appear in this first class, because you will probably be nervous. That's totally normal! We're humans! 

I will listen without judgement and offer a lot of empathy. I will let you speak. I will give you the opportunity to really be heard.

This will allow us to see if working together makes sense. If we decide to continue with another class, what you share in the trial lesson will help me design personalized classes for you - based on your interests, lifestyle needs, goals, strengths, and challenges.

I understand! That's how I feel. I don't like talking about the weather or what I did yesterday or what I am going to do for vacation/holiday.

Instead, I like to hear what people really think, what they have experienced in their lives, and what they care about.

I give students the opportunity to talk about what they LIKE to talk about. Things that interest them. What they like to think and learn about. Their lives. Their world. 

Getting a chance to actually converse, in English, might be just what you're missing - and it can help build your confidence and increase your motivation.

My students are usually people who like to learn - and outside of class they enjoy learning about psychology, philosophy, personal growth, art, creativity, entrepreneurship, and many other things.

Using my educational, professional, and personal experiences, I support learners emotionally and energetically, encouraging habits that enhance English fluency in addition to other areas of life. My teaching is based on Grit: passion and perseverance. I provide engaging topics and area specific homework. It's crucial for learners to study outside class to encounter new vocabulary, grammar, and worldly perspectives. Learning English WILL change your life. I hope to talk soon!

course_info.trial_description: Welcome! Thank you so much for scheduling a trial lesson, I cannot wait to meet you. This first connection will set the theme for the following courses to really get to know each other and design the absolute most successful English plan for you. What is your main focus? What inspires you? What is your preferred learning style and how do you learn best? What are your strengths and weaknesses? Do you like cats or dogs more?? =^.^= this is also to get to know each other, our personalities and lives. In this no-pressure free flow lesson, I will be able to assess your language level and provide insight into the next plan of action, as well as go over class expectations for both of us. Remember: YOU are the captain. This is for you, and I am here in any way to help and adjust to your goals. Let's get started!!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Intermediate Level and Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description: This is where the fun starts! In this course, we will discuss a diverse variety of subjects to best increase your speaking, fluency, and vocabulary with CONFIDENCE in any topic! Music? Cultural traditions? Personal life and hobbies? Entertainment? Travel? Religion and Politics? Philosophy? Comedy? Well, you get the point :) The sky is the limit! My conversation courses are engaging, open, free-flowing, and always fun and full of energy. I am flexible with the focus and always prepared with questions, themes, current event topics, deep thinker conversations, and games. Also, let me know what YOU think and would like to know more about! The more you speak, the more you will improve. Practice makes perfect. Don't be afraid to make mistakes- that means you are human and that is how you learn. Now: less reading, let's get chatting!

pro_course_detail.title: Confidence in Public Speaking, Interviews, and Presentations
pro_course_detail.description: Let's be honest: speaking in front of people in your native language can be nerve-wracking in itself, let alone doing it in a foreign language! But do not lose hope: there are countless ways to prepare yourself and gain confidence so you can ace your next interview, presentation, or debate. In this course, we will focus on two essential concepts: 1) organization and 2) delivery. Organizing will help you develop your plan of action, what to say, how to respond, and what materials you will need. The second focus of delivery covers simply the best way to effectively leave a positive impression on an audience or interviewer and to develop people skills and confidence. The combination of these will carry you to success. Included are mock interviews, practicing presentations, and debates.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Beginners!
pro_course_detail.description: Let's get into the basic fundamental and necessary aspects of English! In this type of lesson, we will review everyday common vocabulary and SOS essential phrases. We will also cover basic grammar structures and have casual and common conversations. My pace will be clear and slow. I am here to support you, don't be scared. We all get nervous speaking in other languages and make mistakes. That is normal! Here I will help you gain confidence to move into the intermediate level. Late's get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English Speaking
pro_course_detail.description: Congratulations! You have made it to the advanced English speaking level. Give yourself a pat on the back because you have worked hard to get here. In this course, the sky is the limit. We will use advanced vocabulary and develop your fluency. Time to perfect pronunciation and dive into deep and interesting topics. Let's get started!

I am a CELTA-certified teacher with over 14 years of experience in all different levels, ages, and objectives. I started in 2009 as a volunteer teacher at an immigration center and fell in love with teaching. I got certified in 2011 in Bogota, Colombia and taught at several language institutes such as International House before becoming a professor at the Externado University of Colombia, one of the best universities in the country. 
My strengths as a teacher are that I am patient and understanding and I really want to get to know you and understand your goals. I am intuitive and creative in finding ways to help you step into using English as an ally in your personal and professional life!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My objective is to be the best guide along your English journey! I will use your goals as a starting point to decide which methodology and materials will work best. As you learn and your needs change, the classes will organically evolve with you!
For conversation classes, we focus on building fluency, confidence, and language range through speaking about diverse topics. 
For General English classes, we will have more clear learning objectives and may use a textbook. 
I target all language skills with a variety of structured and free exercises as well as real-life materials. I also love getting to know you and having fun because that is the most important in learning a new language!

course_info.trial_description: Come meet me and ask me all of your questions! In a trial lesson our goal is to get to know each other better. I will ask you some questions about your English goals and you can ask me questions about me and my classes. If we have time we will play a game! Welcome!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation
pro_course_detail.description: These classes focus on building fluency and confidence through speaking. We will review grammar and build vocabulary naturally as we cover a wide variety of topics using various tenses and types of language. We will cover any other language issues as we go such as pronunciation, comprehension, etc. I will use games, real-world materials, our own lives, and my own material in our classes. I will provide immediate correction to your mistakes and help you understand them so you can stop making them!

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description: Practice in all skills (reading, writing, speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation) personalized for the level and student using real-life material, effective exercises and guidance. We may follow a textbook or other resource if the student desires.
